q1.explanationZh: 第二段说最早的钟是影子钟（shadow clock），也叫日晷。

evidence.quote: Let’s look at the earliest clock: the shadow clock!

q2.explanationZh: 文中说面朝南站着，太阳从东边升起，东边在你的左手边。

evidence.quote: the sun rises from the east (your left)

q3.explanationZh: 第四段说日晷的影子从西到北再到东走。

evidence.quote: its shadow will go from west to north to east

q4.explanationZh: 日晷的影子是顺时针走的，机械钟的指针就照着它的方向转。

evidence.quote: The hands of the clock were made to move clockwise
